source_data: DOGAMI 2014 OLC Metro lidar, highest hit 1 m (data/raw/lidar/highest_hit_utm10n_1m.tif)
frame: world metres: x east, y north; z = elevation NAVD88. *_h_m are heights above ground_z (= ground_mean_z in world/3d/buildings.json).

conventions.azimuth: compass bearing, degrees clockwise from north; ridge azimuths folded to [0,180)
conventions.aspect_deg: downslope direction of a facet, compass bearing
conventions.plane: z = a*x + b*y + c (world metres, z elevation)
conventions.facet.outline: facet region = footprint partitioned by nearest fitted pixel, simplified 0.4 m
conventions.pitch_deg: area-weighted mean slope of the pitched facets (flat: of the flat facets)
conventions.eave_h_m: pitched: facet planes evaluated at the footprint edge; flat: main roof level
conventions.ridge_h_m: highest ridge line (or p97 of pitched roof points if no ridge line); flat: highest major flat level

types.flat: >= 75 % of roof points on facets < 8 deg (flat_levels_h_m lists levels)
types.gabled: two opposite pitched facets carry >= 85 % of pitched points
types.hipped: 3-4 major pitched facets, >= 3 aspect directions, <= 1 ridge, >= 1 hip line, footprint fills > 85 % of its oriented box
types.shed: one pitched facet carries >= 85 % of pitched points
types.complex: everything else; see facets / ridges / hips / valleys

features: tower (> 4 m above roof, >= 9 m2, or a small facet > 4 m above main roof), chimney (<= 6 m2), dormer (<= 40 m2 on a pitched facet, <= 3.5 m), mechanical (on flat roof), raised_block (other), cross_gable (secondary ridge > 60 deg off the main ridge). 1 m lidar: chimneys and dormers are indicative only.
vegetation_rule: pixels with 3x3 detrended roughness > 1 m excluded; unexplained blobs > 1 m above the roof that touch canopy outside the footprint, or are rough (median r3 > 0.6 m, > 6 m2) are vegetation, not structure
confidence: score = explained_frac * (0.5 + 0.5*min(1, n_px/60)) * (1 - 0.6*veg_frac), x0.85 for complex; high >= 0.7, medium >= 0.45, else low
estimate_rule: buildings absent from the 2014 lidar (lidar_2014_absent) or with < 5 returns: see each record's `rule` (>= 600 m2 flat; else 30 deg gable along the long axis)

roofs.name: Student Center
roofs.rule: estimate: no usable 2014 lidar roof (canopy-occluded: fitted eave 19.4 m above ground with 49 % vegetation on a < 500 m2 footprint). Footprint < 600 m2 -> gabled, 30 deg, ridge along the long axis of the minimum rotated rectangle; eave = height - rise (min 2.4 m), height = OSM height/levels x 3.5 m, else 7 m.
